description: RTV-66 real-document assessment benchmark. Doc-sets are REAL, publicly-available vendor DPAs (no NDA); each carries the verbatim clauses extracted from the live document + a human-VALIDATED expected verdict per DORA control (the baseline). scripts/evaluateRealDocs.js ingests each docText through the REAL pipeline (indexArrangementText → Qdrant), runs the REAL retrieval (searchArrangementSpans) + judge (assessControl) per control, and reports coverage + verdict-agreement vs this baseline. Baseline validated by the product owner 2026-09-29 (the 8 judgment calls ruled explicitly). LIMITATION: docText here is the extracted KEY CLAUSES, not the full 30-page DPA — so retrieval quality is optimistic; a follow-up ingests full docs (AWS DPA PDF via Docling is the template).

CLOUDFLARE DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM (extracted clauses).
Annex 2 (Security Measures): Cloudflare uses state-of-the-art encryption protocols designed to provide effective protection against active and passive attacks. Cloudflare employs a code review process to increase the security of the code used to provide the Services. Access controls ensure Personal Data cannot be read, copied or modified or removed without authorization.
Clause 3.1(c): Cloudflare shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risks.
Clause 6.1/6.2: Cloudflare (and its sub-Processors) may process outside of the European Economic Area certain Personal Data; where it does, the EU SCCs will apply, and Cloudflare relies on the Data Privacy Framework for US transfers.
Clause 4.4 (Sub-processors): Cloudflare will maintain a list of sub-Processors and will add the names of new sub-Processors at least thirty (30) days prior to authorising them. If Customer objects on reasonable grounds related to data protection, it shall notify Cloudflare within ten (10) days.
Clause 5.2(c) (Audit): Cloudflare shall enable Customer to request one onsite audit per annual period during the Term. Clause 5.1: Cloudflare shall make available to Customer such information as Customer may reasonably request with a view to demonstrating compliance.
Clause 3.1(e) (Incident): Cloudflare shall without undue delay notify the Customer upon becoming aware of any breach of security leading to a Personal Data Breach.
Clause 8 (Third-Party Data Access Requests): Cloudflare shall immediately notify Customer of the request unless such notification is legally prohibited, and shall pursue legal remedies prior to producing Personal Data up to an appellate court level.
Clause 3.1(i): Following termination or expiry of the Main Agreement, at the choice of Customer, Cloudflare shall delete or return all Personal Data (including copies thereof).

controls.note: ruling 1: a real, exercisable right; cap at 1/yr acceptable

controls.note: ruling 4: covers government data-access requests, not FE competent-authority cooperation

controls.note: ruling 7: return/deletion only, not full transition assistance + portability

STRIPE DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM (extracted clauses; served in French).
Section 2 (Security of Data): Stripe mettra en oeuvre et maintiendra un programme ecrit de securite de l'information integrant les Mesures de securite des donnees (encryption, access controls, availability).
Section 3.1(b): Stripe veille a ce que toutes les personnes que Stripe autorise a Traiter des Donnees personnelles n'y aient acces que si elles ont besoin d'en connaitre (need-to-know confidentiality).
Section 6 (Transfers): l'Utilisateur reconnait que, pour que Stripe puisse fournir les Services, il transfere des Donnees personnelles a Stripe, LLC aux Etats-Unis.
Section 3.2(a) (Sub-processors): Si l'Utilisateur s'abonne aux notifications par e-mail de la Liste des Sous-traitants indirects de Stripe, Stripe l'informera par e-mail de son intention d'ajouter un ou plusieurs Sous-traitants indirects a cette liste au moins 30 jours avant la prise d'effet des modifications.
Section 3.1(g) (Audit): a la demande ecrite de l'Utilisateur, Stripe contribuera aux audits ou inspections en mettant des rapports d'audit a sa disposition.
Section 3.1(f) (Incident): si Stripe subit un Incident de donnees, en informer l'Utilisateur dans les meilleurs delais et, pour les Incidents affectant des Donnees personnelles soumises au RGPD, au plus tard dans les 48 heures.
Section 3.1(d) (Authority): Stripe informera l'Utilisateur de chaque demande emanant d'une Autorite gouvernementale chargee de l'application de la loi, sauf interdiction legale.
Section 3.1(h): au choix de l'Utilisateur, Stripe supprimera ou lui restituera toutes les Donnees personnelles Traitees dans le cadre des Services apres la resiliation du Contrat.

n'y aient acces que si elles ont besoin d'en connaitre
il transfere des Donnees personnelles a Stripe, LLC aux Etats-Unis
Si l'Utilisateur s'abonne aux notifications par e-mail ... au moins 30 jours avant
controls.note: opt-in notification, no explicit object-right shown

controls.note: ruling 2: audit reports only, no inspection/onsite right

chaque demande emanant d'une Autorite gouvernementale chargee de l'application de la loi
controls.note: ruling 5: law-enforcement demand notice, not FE competent-authority cooperation

GOOGLE CLOUD DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM (extracted clauses).
Section 7.1.1 (Security Measures): Google will implement and maintain technical, organizational, and physical measures to protect Customer Data against accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorized disclosure or access. The Security Measures include measures to encrypt Customer Data; to help ensure ongoing confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience of Google's systems and services; to help restore timely access to Customer Data following an incident; and for regular testing of effectiveness.
Section 7.1.2(c): Google will ensure that all persons authorized to process Customer Data are under an obligation of confidentiality.
Section 10.1: Data location commitments are set out under the Service Specific Terms and data transfer commitments under Appendix 3.
Section 11.4 (Subprocessors): Customer has an Opportunity to Object to Subprocessors; Google engages Subprocessors as described in Section 11.
Section 7.5.2(a) (Audit): Google will, if required under Applicable Privacy Law, allow Customer or an independent auditor appointed by Customer to conduct audits (including inspections) to verify Google's compliance with its obligations under this Addendum.
Section 7.2.1 (Incident): Google will notify Customer promptly and without undue delay after becoming aware of a Data Incident, and promptly take reasonable steps to minimize harm and secure Customer Data.
Section 6.2 (Deletion): Customer instructs Google to delete all remaining Customer Data (including existing copies) from Google's systems at the end of the Term; Google will comply within a maximum period of 180 days, unless European Law requires storage.
